parsed.evidence: All 20 top photos are man-made or decorative objects, and the boxes sit on curved boundaries or ornamented patches, while random natural scenes stay near 0. CP_s1.explanation: The unit responds mainly to close-up shots of handmade or manufactured objects with decorative, ornamented surfaces, such as embroidered or printed fabric, embossed metal or clay, crochet, and floral motifs. It responds more weakly to the smooth, rounded contours of plain manufactured objects such as a mouse, shoes, knee pads and a revolver.

parsed.explanation: The unit responds mainly to close-up shots of handmade or manufactured objects with decorative, ornamented surfaces, such as embroidered or printed fabric, embossed metal or clay, crochet, and floral motifs. It responds more weakly to the smooth, rounded contours of plain manufactured objects such as a mouse, shoes, knee pads and a revolver.
parsed.evidence: Most of the top-20 crops show patterned or ornamented crafted surfaces (stockings, pillow, manhole cover, teapot carving, brooch, bib, basket, flag shirt), while #1, #12 and #14 show only curved, shiny object edges; the random photos of animals, scenes and food all sit at 0-2. The unit is unusually robust to rotation (91%, percentile 99) and to edge maps (42%, percentile 87), and somewhat colour-sensitive (grayscale percentile 19), which fits orientation-free contour and pattern shape rather than a specific object part.
parsed.missing_data: Activation on synthetic or controlled stimuli, such as plain curved product edges versus flat decorative patterns, and a larger set of top images, would show whether this is one concept or two.

CPA_s3.explanation: Responds to close-up surfaces of small man-made or handcrafted objects, especially decorated or patterned ones such as embossed or printed motifs, appliqué fabric, crochet and ornamental flowers, with a weaker response to plain glossy black manufactured items (mouse, knee pads, toy gun).

parsed.explanation: Responds to close-up surfaces of small man-made or handcrafted objects, especially decorated or patterned ones such as embossed or printed motifs, appliqué fabric, crochet and ornamental flowers, with a weaker response to plain glossy black manufactured items (mouse, knee pads, toy gun).
parsed.evidence: All 20 top photos are object or product close-ups (textiles, ornaments, accessories, crafts), and random scenes of animals and outdoor settings score 0–2. parsed.missing_data: Activations on plain undecorated objects versus patterned non-object textures (such as natural flower fields or animal fur patterns) would show whether the unit codes 'artifact' or 'decorative pattern'.
